SELECT c.column_name, c.full_data_type, c.is_nullable,
       c.table_catalog, c.table_schema, c.table_name,
       t.table_type
FROM `example-catalog`.information_schema.columns c
JOIN `example-catalog`.information_schema.tables t
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE c.table_schema = lower(?)
  AND c.table_name = lower(?)
ORDER BY c.ordinal_position

SELECT tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name,
       kcu.column_name
FROM `example-catalog`.information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN `example-catalog`.information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
WHERE tc.table_schema = lower(?)
  AND tc.table_name = lower(?)
  AND tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE')

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col.id AS __KUMO_ID__, col.e AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, col.s AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<struct<id:bigint,e:string,s:string>>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `ordered_at`
FROM TMP
JOIN `example-catalog`.`parity_shop`.`orders`
  ON `user_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND `ordered_at` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND `ordered_at` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `ordered_at` <= ?
AND `ordered_at` > ?
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `ordered_at`, `order_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `user_id`

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<bigint>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `age`, `country`, `user_id`
FROM TMP
JOIN `example-catalog`.`parity_shop`.`users`
  ON `user_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `age`, `country`, `user_id`

WITH TMP AS (

  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<struct<id:bigint,e:string,s:string>>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `order_id`, `user_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `ordered_at`
FROM TMP
JOIN `example-catalog`.`parity_shop`.`orders`
  ON `user_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND `ordered_at` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND `ordered_at` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `ordered_at` <= ?
  AND `ordered_at` > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY `ordered_at` DESC, `order_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `user_id`
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `ordered_at` DESC, `order_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `user_id`

WITH TMP AS (

FROM TMP
JOIN `example-catalog`.`parity_shop`.`products`
  ON `product_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `category`, `price`, `product_id`
